description: Add `instructions` string to `createServer()` in `src/server.ts`. Pass it to `McpServer` constructor as `options.instructions` — the SDK's low-level Server class surfaces it in the MCP initialize response. This is how Cursor/Windsurf agents get behavioral guidance without a rules file. Write a test asserting `server.server._instructions` is a non-empty string containing `zug_get_context`.
title: MCP server instructions field
